brief:
Journalist Akbar Shahid Ahmed has published a new book examining how President Joe Biden and senior administration officials backed Israel's military campaign in Gaza despite mounting casualties and escalating concerns over mass civilian harm, Democracy Now! reported. The work, titled "Crossing the Red Line," scrutinizes the policy positions of Biden, his advisers, and Vice President Kamala Harris regarding the conflict.

Ahmed's book documents the administration's stance as the death toll in Gaza mounted and alarm grew among advocates and observers over the conduct of Israel's military operations.

title: Journalist examines Biden administration's support for Israel's Gaza war
